name: Name
productsInfo: Manage product visibility, photos, variants, prices and stock for this shop.
brandsInfo: Add brands and assign them to products in this shop. Shoppers see active brands in the catalogue.
emptyBrandsDescription: Add a brand to assign it to products in this shop.
slugHint: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
logoHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP. Up to 5 MiB.
invalidLogo: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image up to 5 MiB.
deleteBrandDetail: The brand will be removed from products that use it.
brandDeleteConflict: Change the collections that use this brand before deleting it.
categoriesInfo: Organize shop categories. Hiding a category also hides its subcategories from the storefront.
emptyCategoriesDescription: Add a category to organize your products.
categoryUnavailable: Choose a category from this shop.
categorySortHint: Lower numbers come first within the same parent.
categoryCycle: Choose a parent outside this category and its subcategories.
categoryParentUnavailable: Choose a parent category from this shop.
deleteCategoryDetail: A category must be empty before you can delete it.
categoryDeleteConflict: Move its subcategories, remove it from products, and change the collections that use it before deleting this category.
optionsInfo: Define reusable options and the order of their values in this shop.
emptyOptionsDescription: Add an option such as Colour or Size.
optionValueUnavailable: This value is no longer available. Remove it and add it again.
collectionsInfo: Group products by hand or by category or brand.
emptyCollectionsDescription: Add a collection to group products for the storefront.
collectionRefineSearch: Refine your search to see more products.
collectionProductUnavailable: A selected product is no longer available. Remove it from the collection.
collectionSlugInUse: This shop already uses this slug. Enter a unique slug.
characteristicGroupsInfo: Define groups of specifications to show on product pages in this shop.
characteristicGroupsEmptyDescription: Add a group such as Materials to define product specifications.
characteristicGroupSaveFailed: Unable to save the characteristic group.
characteristicDuplicate: This group already uses this name.
characteristicUnavailable: This characteristic is no longer available.
characteristicValueInvalid: The value contains an invalid character.
badgesInfo: Manage product badges for this shop.
emptyBadgesDescription: Add a badge to assign it to products in this shop.
productTagCreationHint: New tags are immediately available in this shop. Save the product to apply the assignment.
productTagNameInUse: A tag already uses this name. Select it from the results.
productBadgeUnavailable: A selected badge is unavailable. Choose badges from this shop.
productTagUnavailable: A selected tag is unavailable. Choose tags from this shop.
productSpecificationsEmpty: Add active characteristics in Characteristic groups to enter values here.
productUnavailable: Unable to load the product editor.
productDescriptionInvalid: The description contains an invalid character.
productImageHint: The first photo is the cover. Add JPEG, PNG or WebP files up to 5 MiB total per save.
productImageInvalid: Choose JPEG, PNG or WebP photos up to 5 MiB each.
productImageBatchTooLarge: New photos can total up to 5 MiB per save.
productImageUnavailable: The preview could not be loaded.
productImageAltInvalid: The alt text contains an invalid character.
productImageIdInvalid: This photo is no longer attached to the product.
brandUnavailable: Choose a brand from this shop.
variantOptionsHint: For a simple product, leave the option values empty. For combinations, select one value from the same options in each variant.
variantNoOptions: Add values under Options to create combinations.
variantDuplicateSku: This shop already uses the SKU. Enter a unique SKU.
variantDuplicateCombination: This product already has this combination.
variantInvalidValues: Choose one value per option from this shop.
variantMismatchedOptions: Use the same options in every variant.
variantUnavailable: This variant changed. Reopen the product to refresh it.
optionValueInUse: Product variants use the removed value. Cancel and reopen the option, or remove the value from the affected variants first.
